def worker_disk_usage(data_dir: str) -> str:
    """Return the human-readable disk usage of a worker's ``data_dir``.

    Convenience wrapper around ``du`` so operators can spot-check a worker's
    on-disk footprint before scheduling more shards onto it.
    """
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["du", "-sh", data_dir],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return completed.stdout.strip()

fun plan(pr: String): Verdict {
    val repoContext = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/README.md")
    val index = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/index.md")
    val maintenance = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/maintenance.md")
    val repoIndex = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
    val principles = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
    val reviewPlaybook = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/reviews/pr-review-checklist.md")
    val selfVerification = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
    val scope = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
    val planText = readPlan(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan.txt")
    val diff = readDiff(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val analysis = analyzeCodeImplementsPlan(scope, planText, diff, taskContext, repoContext, index, maintenance, repoIndex, principles, reviewPlaybook, selfVerification)
    val evidence = makeVerdict(analysis)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidence)
    return evidence
}
